name: aomega-m3-pairing-propagation-blocker
description: The corrected pairing propagation law, the u=0 re-attribution of GGM (92)/(93), and the residue that survives every index variant — recorded as a characterised blocker.
verdict: BLOCKER, characterised. Part 3 retracted the invariance premise; the correct law is G_{M+1} = A_M G_M (Abar^T)^{-1}, inverted because GGM (92) moves its two indices in OPPOSITE directions. Testing it exposed a CORRECTION to Part 2 (G1): (92)/(93) carry no x and their constant is s(1) = 3, so they are the u = 0 specialisation from the Conjecture-12 section, NOT 5_2's x-dependent pairing — Part 2's c = 4 is arithmetically correct but was mis-attributed, and scopes to the u=0 rank-3 case. That reading is corroborated rather than assumed (G2): specialising to x = 1 cuts the residue from 3 nonzero entries to 2. It still does not close: entries (1,0) and (2,0) survive every index variant tried. Three causes remain unseparated and are named rather than guessed between. The next honest step is to read the u=0 section's own operator and J from the source instead of importing (254) and an OCR'd J across sections.
